svg.text: Agent Loops · Where each component keeps its data
Each row is one store: what it holds, and its path or key. Agent records and transcripts live on their machine; the control plane holds them only in sealed host backups.
Files are whole-file JSON (written atomically) or append-only JSONL.
App/, Shared/UI · SwiftUI · one app with the host

The store: one JSON object per record
